title: two journals that grew apart meet without forking the chain
intention: cairn/tools/artifact: when two branches or two sessions both append to .artifact-journal.jsonl, git's text merge conflicts or leaves two entries chained to one prev, and the repair is a hand re-link. The artifact tool now carries git's merge driver for the journal: it keeps one side byte for byte, appends the other side's entries it lacks (matched by body, not sha) and re-links only those, so the result replays clean from genesis.
why: Measured 2026-11-11 at 6d324d26343d's PROVED push: upstream HEAD's journal was already forked at entry 16162 (peer superclaude-2782 had chained off entry 16018) and CC re-linked it by hand before pushing; verify_chain reds a fork. Measured 2026-11-12 in a scratch repo: two branches that each append two entries conflict on git merge (rc 1, CONFLICT (content)). Outline 3.3.6 puts each ticket on its own branch, which makes every landing such a meeting.
traces_to: CLAUDE.md RULE 1; outline 17.2 (artifact: the journal of who came through it, hash-chained); outline 17.13.1.
how: cairn/tools/artifact/artifact.py: merge_journals(ours, theirs) -> bytes, with _identity (body less prev and entry) and _parse_journal. cairn/tools/artifact/__main__.py: verbs merge-journal %O %A %B (writes over %A, as git requires) and install-merge-driver <root> (git config merge.cairn-journal.name and .driver, a PYTHONPATH'd python -m command). Both roots' .gitattributes name .artifact-journal.jsonl merge=cairn-journal. New proof proofs/test_two_journals_meet_without_forking.py over a scratch repo.

clauses.claim: a merge of two branches that both appended takes no conflict, holds every entry once, and replays clean from genesis
the side merged into keeps its own lines byte for byte, and incoming entries keep their bodies, re-linked only in prev and entry
a rebase meets the same way, and meeting copies an earlier merge re-linked does not duplicate them

decisions.text: D1: the journal is met by a git merge driver the artifact tool carries; one side kept whole, the other's missing entries re-linked onto its tail.

measured.saw: encapsulation_holds finds cairn/tools/artifact/artifact.py:305 (verify_chain); cairn/tools/artifact/artifact.py:319 (_append, the one-tree lock that cannot reach across branches)
